title.en: Agents shown with their official icons
title.zh: 智能体图标改用官方图标

description.en: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek, Gemini, Qwen Code and other agents now use the same icons as their own sites and apps, at a consistent size, and stay clear in both light and dark mode.
description.zh: Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、DeepSeek、Gemini、Qwen Code 等智能体改用与其官网、客户端一致的图标，尺寸统一，在浅色与深色模式下均清晰可辨。
